name: OryphemCoin
description: OryphemCoin (OPC) is the gamified reward currency of the QLoot learning platform. It is an ERC-1155 multi-token with token id 0 used as the primary reward balance, treated as an integer point unit (decimals = 0).

utility: Reward for learning, quests and exams
properties.custodial_note: Treasury holds tokens on-chain; per-user balances are tracked in the QLoot off-chain double-entry ledger and can be withdrawn to a personal wallet.
